references.title: Low back pain and sciatica in over 16s: assessment and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked. The landing page shows Published 30 November 2016 and Last updated 29 July 2026. The Update information section states that in July 2026 NICE withdrew the recommendations on psychological therapy for low back pain or sciatica. Earlier recorded updates include the December 2020 review of opioid recommendations for non-cancer pain.

references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked. The landing page shows Published 17 February 2016 and does not display a separate Last updated date. references.title: Gout: diagnosis and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 9 June 2022 and no separate Last updated date. The guideline directs clinicians assessing a painful red swollen joint to consider septic arthritis, calcium pyrophosphate crystal deposition and inflammatory arthritis, and to refer immediately through the local pathway when septic arthritis is suspected.
